models_evaluated: 15 LLMs (general-purpose, medical-purpose, closed-source, downstream SFT models)

links.outcome: Effect of external guardrail models on blocking unsafe high-risk medical queries and outputs
links.effect: External guardrails reduced some failures but introduced brittle blocking and weak safe helpfulness; no numbers in the abstract.
links.quote: Results reveal a substantial gap between apparent alignment and medical safety: aligned models can still produce unsafe or actionable responses, medical fine-tuning can amplify harmful specificity, and external guardrails reduce some failures while introducing brittle blocking and weak safe helpfulness.

unlisted_practices: Medical fine-tuning of LLMs (found to amplify harmful specificity)
Reliance on general alignment or medical capability as a proxy for medical safety

screen.practice: external guardrail models as output filters
screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs and the effect of external guardrail models against a high-risk medical safety benchmark (MedHarm).
